repo_notes.content: Agentic Operations is a manufacturing decision-case application packaged as one Hermes plugin. Runtime code is self-contained under plugin/hermes_ops. Core services own state transitions; tools and UI invoke the same services. Demo company data is synthetic.
repo_notes.author: Project maintainers
